info.name: BloodHound AD Base Entities AD Users API

params.name: object_id
params.description: The object id of the entity being operated on.

params.name: counts
params.description: Include counts of related entities. Default value is `true`.

items.docs: Get info and counts for this User node.

params.name: object_id
params.description: The object id of the entity being operated on.

params.name: skip
params.description: The number of entries to skip for pagination. Only available for `type=list`.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of entries to limit in the response. Only available for `type=list`.

params.name: type
params.description:
The type of return data requested. If no type is provided, query will default to `list`.
The only supported type is `list`, but the unsupported `graph` type can be used.
Some entity query endpoints do not support the `graph` type. For those interested in
using the undocumented graph type parameter, the response type is described in the schema
`model.bh-graph.graph`.

params.name: sort_by
params.description:
Sort by column. Can be used multiple times; prepend a hyphen for descending order. Columns available
for sorting are dependent on the entity object kind.

items.docs: Get a list, graph, or count of the systems this user has admin rights to.
